lines.text: 张阿姨笑着说：“把你送到终点，我就回去接着跑了。我报的是全程，四十二公里。”
lines.py: Zhāng ā yí xiào zhe shuō: “bǎ nǐ sòng dào zhōng diǎn, wǒ jiù huí qù jiē zhe pǎo le. wǒ bào de shì quán chéng, sì shí èr gōng lǐ.”
lines.en: Auntie Zhang laughs. "Once I'd got you to the finish, I went back and carried on. I'd entered the full marathon: forty-two kilometres."
